record.summary: Studio Gang's 23-story, 254-unit rental tower at 1070 Bridgeview Way, the fourth and last Phase 1 building. Construction started March 2022, leasing began April 2024, residents moved in from June 2024 and the ribbon was cut September 3, 2024; 59 of its units are below market rate after a 2024 re-mix toward 90% AMI. Chipotle's own location page for 365 Toni Stone Xing, Unit C gives an opening date of September 23, 2026 (a date stated by the business, on a page captured the next day).

open_questions: Commercial Property Executive's July 14, 2026 article (the only source for the $116.2 million Wells Fargo construction loan and the $117.8 million Ares Management loan) refused access on 2026-10-12, and a second page listed in a web search for the same loan (traded.co) did too, so neither amount, lender nor what the Ares loan replaced is confirmed by a page read here.

Jobs Housing Equivalency Fee subsidy received by Parcel F: the Port's September 2019 budget report lists a minimum of 75.6 ($ millions) for Parcel F when it was planned with 106 below-market units (it has 59), and says the residential projects "will request a proportionate share of the JHEF when the residential building foundations have been completed"; no source read gives the amount actually paid to Parcel F.

Construction cost: no source read states one. DBI permit 201910073784 carries a $99,907,840 estimated and revised cost, which is a filed permit valuation rather than a cost, and the only financing figure is the reported $116.2 million Wells Fargo loan, which is unconfirmed (see the first question).

Exact TCO date: the Port's October 2023 memo projected a June 2024 TCO, and its April 2024 memo said Parcel F "is expected to receive a Temporary Certificate of Occupancy (TCO) in May" with move-ins in June 2024 (both are projections); no document read gives the date the TCO was issued.
Topping-out date: the Port's October 2023 memo only says it had topped out; no dated press item found.

Total square footage disagrees across sources (287,000 / 314,508 / 315,000 / 330,000: a trade-press article reposted by Mitsui Fudosan America, the Port's 2019 appraisal table, the 2026 refinancing report, and SF YIMBY in March 2022); no document read says which is the gross floor area, and the DBI permit records read carry no floor area.

Images: no 'before' photo is hosted (until 2020 the parcel was the Seawall Lot 337 surface parking lot) and no rendering is hosted because the architects' renderings are not openly licensed; they are reachable through the architect sources listed here.

A Mapillary storefront photo of Ike's Love & Sandwiches (a sourced retail tenant, see the retail fact above) was hosted briefly and then removed: on review it read as too cluttered (a trash bin, a parked car and several pedestrians in front of the sign) to keep. Still on the shot list for a cleaner frame.
Arsicault Bakery's Verde shop is shown open on a March 11, 2025 release; it has not been re-confirmed since.

A business registration for BVNK at 365 Toni Stone Xing Fl 3 exists since 2025-03-30 (System Pay Services (Us), Inc., no end date, DataSF Registered Business Locations); no source read shows an office open there, so BVNK is not listed as a tenant. Searches found no page that names BVNK at Mission Rock.

Chipotle Mexican Grill is shown open from 2026-09-23. That date is the 'c_openDate' on Chipotle's own location page for 365 Toni Stone Xing (locations.chipotle.com, whose data carries a timestamp of 2026-09-24 and which was read on 2026-10-12); it is a date the company states, not one confirmed by a news report or a visit. The page lists daily hours of 10:45 a.m. to 10 p.m. and online ordering. DataSF has a registration for Chipotle Mexican Grill #5956 at suite C from 2026-08-25, which is a registration date, not an opening date.

First move-in month: SF YIMBY (September 4, 2024) says the building "has been open to new residents since June", while the Port's March 2025 memo says "As of February 2025, seven months into lease-up", which would put the start of lease-up around July 2024. No certificate of occupancy or lease document read dates the first move-in, so "June 2024" is approximate.

Resolution number for the Board of Supervisors' March 6, 2018 action: the Port's October 2023 memo gives Resolution 33-18 for the Board's affirmation of the EIR certification, but the same memo (and the Port's September 2019 and April 2024 reports) also cites Resolution 33-18 for the Board's February 2018 approval of the Development Agreement (with Resolution 42-18 for the DDA); the Notice of Determination gives only File No. 171286.

Unit mix of Verde: SF YIMBY (Sept 2024) gives 30 studios, 129 one-bedrooms, 91 two-bedrooms and 4 three-bedrooms; the Port's March 2025 memo, Table 2 'Parcel F Housing Table 2022', gives 30 studios, 132 one-bedrooms, 88 two-bedrooms and 4 three-bedrooms.

Total square footage of Verde, by source: 314,508 total per the 2019 Port appraisal table; 287,000 per a Yield Pro article of April 30, 2024 reposted by Mitsui Fudosan America; 330,000 per SF YIMBY (March 2022); 315,000 per the 2026 refinancing report, whose page was unreadable, so that figure is unconfirmed.

LEED rating of Verde: Mission Rock's April 2024 release (via Yield Pro) and Studio Gang's undated page, written after June 2024, both say "targeting" LEED Gold; the 2026 refinancing report is cited as calling it certified, but that page was unreadable, so certification is unconfirmed.
